<view class="page">
  <view class="header">
    <text class="title">等额本息房贷计算器</text>
    <text class="subtitle">金额单位：元 · 年利率单位：% · 期限单位：月</text>
  </view>

  <view class="card">
    <view class="field">
      <text class="label">贷款金额（元）</text>
      <input
        class="input"
        id="principal"
        type="digit"
        placeholder="请输入贷款金额，如 120000"
        value="{{principal}}"
        bindinput="onPrincipalInput"
      />
    </view>

    <view class="field">
      <text class="label">年利率（%）</text>
      <input
        class="input"
        id="rate"
        type="digit"
        placeholder="请输入年利率，如 4.9"
        value="{{rate}}"
        bindinput="onRateInput"
      />
    </view>

    <view class="field">
      <text class="label">贷款期限（月）</text>
      <input
        class="input"
        id="months"
        type="number"
        placeholder="请输入期限月数，如 360"
        value="{{months}}"
        bindinput="onMonthsInput"
      />
    </view>

    <view class="error" wx:if="{{errorMsg}}">{{errorMsg}}</view>

    <view class="actions">
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="calc" type="primary" bindtap="onCalc">计算</button>
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" id="reset" bindtap="onReset">重置</button>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="card result-card">
    <view class="result-row">
      <text class="result-label">每月还款（元）</text>
      <text class="result-value" id="monthly">{{monthly}}</text>
    </view>
    <view class="result-row">
      <text class="result-label">总利息（元）</text>
      <text class="result-value" id="totalInterest">{{totalInterest}}</text>
    </view>
    <view class="result-row">
      <text class="result-label">还款总额（元）</text>
      <text class="result-value" id="totalPay">{{totalPay}}</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
